<div class="concept-explorer volume-explorer">
  <header class="volume-header"><p class="eyebrow">ML SYSTEMS TAXONOMY · VOLUME MAPS</p><h1>Volume maps</h1><p>Explore one concept map per volume. Chapters locate concepts in the map; labeled arrows explain how the ideas relate.</p><a class="field-entry" href="index.html">Open the full ML Systems Taxonomy ↗</a></header>
  <nav id="volume-buttons" class="volume-buttons" aria-label="Choose a volume"></nav>
  <header class="map-header"><h2 id="map-title">Loading the volume map…</h2><p id="map-description"></p></header>
  <button id="return-overview" type="button" hidden>Back to the volume map</button>
  <div class="map-tools"><label>Map view <select id="map-selector" aria-label="Choose a concept map"></select></label><label>Locate a chapter <select id="chapter-selector" aria-label="Highlight a chapter"><option value="">Whole volume</option></select></label><button id="focus-chapter" type="button" disabled>Zoom to chapter</button><label>Find a concept <input id="concept-search" type="search" placeholder="Search this map…"></label><button id="reset-view" type="button">Show all connections</button><div class="map-zoom" role="group" aria-label="Map zoom"><button id="zoom-out" type="button" aria-label="Zoom out">−</button><button id="zoom-fit" type="button">Fit map</button><button id="zoom-in" type="button" aria-label="Zoom in">+</button><output id="zoom-status" aria-label="Map zoom level">100%</output></div><a id="expand-map" class="expand-map" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener" hidden>Expand interactive map ↗</a><a id="download-map" href="#" download>Download map ↗</a></div>
  <p id="chapter-context" class="chapter-context" role="status">Click a concept to follow its connections across chapter boundaries.</p>
  <div class="volume-map-workspace"><div><div class="map-frame"><div id="concept-map" aria-label="Interactive concept map"><p>Loading the concept map…</p></div></div><p class="map-caption"><span>FOCUS QUESTION</span> <span id="focus-question"></span><span id="map-context" class="map-draft"></span></p></div><div class="volume-concept-reader" role="complementary"><button id="focus-connections" type="button" disabled>Zoom to these connections</button><section id="concept-detail" tabindex="-1" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Selected concept"><h2>Follow a connection</h2><p>Select a concept. Read its claim, follow a labeled arrow to another concept, and open either explanation in the book.</p></section></div></div>
  <section id="map-coverage" class="map-coverage" aria-label="Map coverage"></section>
  <section class="concept-index" aria-labelledby="concept-index-title"><h2 id="concept-index-title">Concepts in this map</h2><p id="result-status" role="status"></p><div id="concept-list"></div><section id="learning-checks" aria-label="Check understanding"></section></section>
  <p class="editorial-note">These volume maps are an editorial draft of the major conceptual connections across chapters. They are not yet an exhaustive map of every teaching concept. Concept-level maps cite supporting book sections; a visible arrow is not a prerequisite or a required reading sequence.</p>
  <noscript><p>The interactive map requires JavaScript. The book’s chapter explanations remain available through the Read menu.</p></noscript>
</div>
<script src="vendor/cytoscape.min.js" defer></script>
<script src="atlas.js" defer></script>
<script src="explorer.js" defer></script>
